title: station trace line
description: One line of a back core's trace.jsonl (ruling E15-7): one station visit, one reader summons, or one station refused before the visit. Closed at every level. A visit or summons carries the identity the station's own CLI returned, the route that resolved it, the run directory the visit used and its terminal status; a summons also names its call id and readers row; a refused line names the refusal's rules. Shared by vertical-v2, handoff-v2 and ship-v2 (references/back-files.txt).

trace_version.description: the version of this line shape

seq.description: the 0-based line index; file order is time order

at.description: UTC instant the line was written

kind.description: visit: a station run; summons: a reader call; refused: a station refused before the visit

caller.description: the back core that wrote the line

expected.description: the name the caller expected the station to carry (a -v2 station, or readers)

identity.description: the identity the station's own CLI returned before the visit; null only on a refused line whose station could not be read

root.description: the resolved root of the station's plugin

interface_version.description: the interface version the station's CLI reported

route.description: how the station's root was resolved; null only on a refused line

run_dir.description: the run directory the visit used (or would have used)

status.description: the visit's or the call's terminal status, as the station or readers reported it

call_id.description: summons only: the readers call id

refusal.description: refused only: why the station was refused before the visit
